subject.title: feat(agents): add description field for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should configured nonblank `agents.list[].description` text be intentionally exposed to model sessions authorized to invoke `agents_list`?
rationale: The patch is additive and has focused Gateway proof, but accepting the feature establishes a durable security/product contract for arbitrary operator-authored configuration text.

options.title: Accept authorized discovery metadata
options.body: Treat descriptions as non-secret capability summaries and merge the current optional field for authorized `agents_list` callers.

options.title: Narrow the surface first
options.body: Require a dedicated sanitized capability field or a different access boundary before exposing free-form descriptions to models.

options.title: Decline model-visible descriptions
options.body: Keep descriptions as configuration-only metadata and close this feature direction without adding it to tool output.

recommendation.title: Accept authorized discovery metadata
recommendation.body: Treat descriptions as non-secret capability summaries and merge the current optional field for authorized `agents_list` callers.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent work establishes the surviving `agents.list[].description` metadata contract that this PR would newly expose at runtime.
